entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'd like to start a return for an order I received a few weeks ago.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with the order number?
Sure, it's VF8675309. It was for a new helmet.
Thank you. I see the order here. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. Honestly, the color just wasn't what I was expecting from the photos online. The box is still unopened, so it's in brand new condition.
I understand completely. So just to confirm, there are no concerns with the fit or any of the safety features of the helmet?
No, not at all. VeloFit's commitment to safety is why I shop with you. This is purely about the aesthetic.
Thank you for clarifying. I'm looking at your order details, and it was delivered 24 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can definitely approve this return for a full refund.

That's good to hear. Now, since I'm going through the hassle of shipping this back and placing a new order, and given the color wasn't quite as advertised, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable request. Let me check your account... Ah, I see you're a VIP member with us. In that case, I'd be happy to add a 15% discount coupon to your account. You can use it on your next order with us. How does that sound?
A 15% discount is perfect, thank you for that. I appreciate you working with me.

Of course! I've just emailed you the prepaid return label. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it at any shipping center. The discount code is now active on your VeloFit account. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
